Definition: neuter diminutive of G3816; a childling (of either sex), i.e. (properly), an infant, or (by extension) a half-grown boy or girl; figuratively, an immature Christian:--(little, young) child, damsel.
BiblicalUsage: Paidion is the little child, the infant or young boy or girl. Herod sends the wise men to find the young child, Jesus sets a little child in the midst of His disciples and says whoever does not receive the kingdom as a little child shall not enter it, and after the resurrection He calls His disciples children from the shore.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the child is the measure of the kingdom. Small, trusting, and entirely dependent is not a stage to outgrow but the posture to keep.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
